scope: Independent LibreOffice ODF encryption interoperability and CFB64 reader repair. Preserve the existing standards-based CFB8 implementation.
finding: LibreOffice calls its Blowfish mode CFB8, but advances an offset modulo eight and uses EVP_bf_cfb: eight-byte CFB64 feedback. All six original AES exports open; both original eight-bit CFB8 exports are refused. Original native ODF1.0/1.1 Blowfish files fail current SDK checksum verification. The reader now selects CFB64 on CFB8 checksum mismatch after admitting both attempts before password access.

independentNativeMemberDecryption.oracle: Manual OpenSSL BF-CFB64/AES-CBC with independent PBKDF2 and raw inflate; product has no native crypto fallback.
